comparison.objective: Prepare coffee using a spring-return cup shelf and return the filled mug safely; candidate finishes HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Shelf actuation, vessel positioning, and spill-free liquid handling versus precision mandrel stabilization, hammering, and tiny-fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: 120 ml retained, no spill or unsafe contact, mug on its own saucer versus four fractures, four contained tangs, no insert displacement or damage, and stable release.
comparison.reason: The coffee task tests constrained vessel and liquid safety rather than hardware fracture.
